name: mb_constable
note: A constable of 1865 in the dress of the British and Irish constabularies of the day, after which Jamaica's police were modelled: a fitted dark tunic buttoned to a stand collar, a pale belt, a peaked cap. No picture of a Jamaican constable of 1865 was found: a general picture (docs/games/morant-bay.md). The tunic is built as a fitted shirt (fitted sleeves and shoulders); the builder's loose coat gave puffy shoulders and bell sleeves (owner, 23 November 2026).
